executor_result.summary: Add focused handoff scoring freshness regression test proving context-only evidence cannot refresh scoring freshness fields in part2/capital_flow/tests/test_v1_handoff.py

instructions: Add one focused regression to part2/capital_flow/tests/test_v1_handoff.py proving the new family-level scoring-only freshness fields in the Anata handoff cannot be refreshed by newer context_only evidence. Construct one older scoring FlowObservation and one newer context_only FlowObservation in the same family. Assert visible/context support remains visible, while scoring_latest_effective_at_ms, scoring_latest_available_at_ms, scoring_latest_observed_at_ms and their scoring_*_age_ms values are derived only from the older scoring observation. Preserve all existing tests and semantics. Do not modify production code unless the requested behavior is impossible, and this task does not authorize production-file writes.
title: add handoff scoring freshness regression
